name: Ranger
theme: Masters of the wild and patient hunters, Rangers live for the open air and the satisfaction of a well-placed shot. Whether stalking prey through dense forest or shadowing an enemy force from a ridgeline, Rangers are built for striking from afar and surviving in hostile terrain. In a party, Rangers excel at reconnaissance, harrying enemies from distance, and controlling the battlefield’s range. Their craft blends precision marksmanship with tactical movement — keeping foes off-balance and allies well-informed.

tier_skills.name: Hunter’s Instinct
tier_skills.flavor: Flow like wind, strike like a falling hawk.
tier_skills.humanReadableMechanics: Activate: free. Move up to half your speed without provoking; then make a Martial or Ranged attack at +1 Fortune. On hit, target’s movement is halved until end of its next turn.

tier_skills.name: Master of the Wilds
tier_skills.flavor: The wild bends to your will.
tier_skills.humanReadableMechanics: Activate stance for 3 rounds. In natural terrain: +2 Fortune on Martial/Ranged; enemies you hit cannot Hide until your next turn; once per stance you may Track Prey (free). Your attacks gain penetration 2 vs hide/chitin/scale.

tier_skills.name: Apex Predator
tier_skills.flavor: When the apex hunts, the world grows quiet.
tier_skills.humanReadableMechanics: Choose up to 3 enemies at max range; make one attack roll vs each. Each hit adds +10 Risk. Regain 1 Tier Die per defeated enemy. This volley ignores resistance to piercing and slashing.
